Hospital costs in India double every five years

According to MoSPI's NSS 2025 survey, a typical private‑hospital stay costs about ₹24,000 (≈$248) out of pocket. Aon projects employer medical plan costs to rise 11.5% in 2026 after a 13% jump in 2025, showing costs keep climbing. Does that change how you view needing your own coverage?

National Health Accounts 2022‑23 show households covered roughly 43% of all health spending directly out of pocket. IRDAI's 2024‑25 data indicate the average health claim paid was about ₹28,900 (~$299). Does that make the risk of large bills feel more real to you?
